install:
set -euo pipefail

# 1. uv — the resolver/installer used for every step below.
#    --break-system-packages is the documented uv/pip escape hatch for a
#    base image whose system python3 is PEP 668 externally-managed (e.g. a
#    stock Ubuntu apt python3); it is a harmless no-op otherwise.
#    https://docs.astral.sh/uv/pip/environments/
python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade --break-system-packages uv

# 2. mcp-audit plus every optional extra the ubuntu/3.12 `test-all-extras`
#    job in .github/workflows/ci.yml installs — generated FROM that file at
#    install time, not restated here, so this can never drift from the CI
#    cell it mirrors (R53). If ci.yml's job name or install-line shape ever
#    changes, this fails loudly and refuses to fall back to a hardcoded
#    extras list — see CONTRIBUTING.md.
_CI_YML=".github/workflows/ci.yml"
if [ ! -f "${_CI_YML}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: ${_CI_YML} not found - cannot derive the extras list this environment installs. Refusing to fall back to a hardcoded default." >&2
  exit 1
fi
_job_block="$(sed -n '/^  test-all-extras:/,/^  [a-zA-Z_-]*:$/p' "${_CI_YML}")"
if [ -z "${_job_block}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: could not find a 'test-all-extras:' job in ${_CI_YML}. Expected job name has moved or been renamed - refusing to fall back to a hardcoded extras list. Fix this script to match the new job name." >&2
  exit 1
fi
_extras_line="$(printf '%s\n' "${_job_block}" | grep -oE '"\.\[[a-zA-Z0-9,_-]+\]"' | head -n1)"
if [ -z "${_extras_line}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: found the 'test-all-extras' job in ${_CI_YML} but no line matching the expected shape  uv pip install -e \".[extra1,extra2,...]\" ...  inside it. Refusing to fall back to a hardcoded extras list. Fix this script to match the new install-step shape." >&2
  exit 1
fi
_EXTRAS="$(printf '%s' "${_extras_line}" | tr -d '".[]')"
if [ -z "${_EXTRAS}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: matched a bracketed extras expression in ${_CI_YML} but it parsed to an empty string. Refusing to fall back to a hardcoded extras list." >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "Extras derived from ${_CI_YML} (test-all-extras job): ${_EXTRAS}"
python3 -m uv pip install -e ".[${_EXTRAS}]" --system --break-system-packages

# 3. semgrep — installed SYSTEM-WIDE via pipx, deliberately OUTSIDE the
#    Python environment mcp-audit's own deps live in. pysemgrep breaks with
#    a pkg_resources import error under capture_output=True (used by
#    src/mcp_audit/sast/runner.py) when it shares an environment with
#    mcp-audit's deps — see the `dev` extra's comment in pyproject.toml and
#    the ".cursor/environment.json" note in CONTRIBUTING.md. pipx's
#    isolated venv plus its ~/.local/bin script is exactly what
#    sast/runner.py::find_semgrep() resolves via shutil.which("semgrep").
python3 -m pip install --quiet --user --break-system-packages pipx
python3 -m pipx ensurepath >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
python3 -m pipx install semgrep
# Belt-and-suspenders PATH resolution: ~/.local/bin only lands on PATH for
# shells that source ~/.bashrc (pipx ensurepath edits that file). Mirror the
# symlink into /usr/local/bin, which is on PATH for every shell type, when
# writable — a no-op if not.
if [ -w /usr/local/bin ] || [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ]; then
  ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/semgrep" /usr/local/bin/semgrep 2>/dev/null || true
fi

# 4. cosign — pinned to v3.0.6, the DEFAULT `cosign-release` that this
#    project's ci.yml installs via sigstore/cosign-installer@6f9f177...
#    (v4.1.2, test-all-extras job). That default lives inside the third-party
#    installer action's own action.yml, not as a value in ci.yml, so it
#    cannot be parsed from this repo the way the extras list above can — it
#    is pinned here by hand. docs/offline-verification-findings.md's
#    measurements are pinned to this exact cosign version; re-pin both
#    together if ci.yml's installer SHA ever moves. See CONTRIBUTING.md for
#    the full provenance. Verified against the exact SHA-256 the installer
#    action itself checks (never trust-on-first-use of a downloaded binary).
#    Degrades gracefully: an unsupported OS/arch or a failed
#    download/checksum warns and continues rather than failing the whole
#    install — TestCosignRoundTrip and friends will then skip audibly
#    (STEP 4 / `pytest -rs`) rather than fail the box.
_COSIGN_VERSION="v3.0.6"
_cosign_os="$(uname -s)"
_cosign_arch="$(uname -m)"
case "${_cosign_os}-${_cosign_arch}" in
  Linux-x86_64)
    _cosign_asset="cosign-linux-amd64"
    _cosign_sha="c956e5dfcac53d52bcf058360d579472f0c1d2d9b69f55209e256fe7783f4c74"
    ;;
  Linux-aarch64)
    _cosign_asset="cosign-linux-arm64"
    _cosign_sha="bedac92e8c3729864e13d4a17048007cfafa79d5deca993a43a90ffe018ef2b8"
    ;;
  Darwin-x86_64)
    _cosign_asset="cosign-darwin-amd64"
    _cosign_sha="4c3e7af8372d3ca3296e62fa56f23fcbb5721cc6ac1827900d398f110d7cd280"
    ;;
  Darwin-arm64)
    _cosign_asset="cosign-darwin-arm64"
    _cosign_sha="5fadd012ae6381a6a29ff86a7d39aa873878852f1073fc90b15995961ecfb084"
    ;;
  *)
    _cosign_asset=""
    ;;
esac
if [ -z "${_cosign_asset}" ]; then
  echo "WARNING: unsupported OS/arch ${_cosign_os}-${_cosign_arch} for cosign ${_COSIGN_VERSION} - skipping install; signing tests will skip audibly (see CONTRIBUTING.md)." >&2
else
  _cosign_tmp="$(mktemp)"
  if ! curl --retry 3 -fsSL "https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/releases/download/${_COSIGN_VERSION}/${_cosign_asset}" -o "${_cosign_tmp}"; then
    echo "WARNING: could not download cosign ${_COSIGN_VERSION} - skipping install; signing tests will skip audibly (see CONTRIBUTING.md)." >&2
    rm -f "${_cosign_tmp}"
  else
    _cosign_got_sha="$( (shasum -a 256 "${_cosign_tmp}" 2>/dev/null || sha256sum "${_cosign_tmp}" 2>/dev/null) | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    if [ "${_cosign_got_sha}" != "${_cosign_sha}" ]; then
      echo "WARNING: cosign ${_COSIGN_VERSION} checksum mismatch (expected ${_cosign_sha}, got ${_cosign_got_sha}) - skipping install; signing tests will skip audibly (see CONTRIBUTING.md)." >&2
      rm -f "${_cosign_tmp}"
    else
      mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
      mv "${_cosign_tmp}" "$HOME/.local/bin/cosign"
      chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/cosign"
      if [ -w /usr/local/bin ] || [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ]; then
        ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/cosign" /usr/local/bin/cosign 2>/dev/null || true
      fi
    fi
  fi
fi

# 5. minisign — apt, matching ci.yml exactly ("Ubuntu's apt repo ships a
#    current build; no separate installer action exists"). Degrades
#    gracefully: no apt-get, no root, and no passwordless sudo all warn and
#    continue rather than failing the whole install — a cloud agent that
#    cannot install minisign still gets a usable box, but STEP 4's
#    `pytest -rs` verify block will then show "minisign is not installed"
#    skips rather than pass quietly. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
if command -v minisign >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  :
elif ! command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "WARNING: apt-get not found - cannot install minisign (this project's install matches ci.yml's apt-based install); signing tests will skip audibly (see CONTRIBUTING.md)." >&2
elif [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ]; then
  apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y minisign || echo "WARNING: apt-get install minisign failed - signing tests will skip audibly (see CONTRIBUTING.md)." >&2
elif command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
  sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y minisign || echo "WARNING: apt-get install minisign failed - signing tests will skip audibly (see CONTRIBUTING.md)." >&2
else
  echo "WARNING: no root or passwordless sudo - cannot install minisign; signing tests will skip audibly (see CONTRIBUTING.md)." >&2
fi

# 6. Playwright — chromium only. No test in this repo exercises firefox or
#    webkit; CI's ubuntu/3.12 leg installs all three defensively, but that
#    is not needed to run the standard verify block here.
python3 -m playwright install chromium
python3 -m playwright install-deps chromium
